+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source, expected', [
+    (b'#!/usr/bin/python3.8 -I\nprint(1)\n', '#!/usr/bin/python3.8 -I'),
+    (b'#!/opt/venv/bin/python\nprint(1)\n', '#!/opt/venv/bin/python'),
+    (b'#!/usr/bin/ruby -w\nputs 1\n', '#!/usr/bin/ruby -w'),
+])
+def test_preserves_module_shebang(mocker, templar, source, expected):
+    mocker.patch('builtins.open', mocker.mock_open(read_data=source))
+    data, style, shebang = modify_module('fake_module', 'fake_path', {}, templar)
+    assert shebang == expected
+    assert data.startswith(expected.encode() + b'\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n')
+
+
+def test_shebang_override_for_versioned_python(mocker, templar):
+    mocker.patch('builtins.open', mocker.mock_open(read_data=b'#!/usr/bin/python3.8 -I\nprint(1)\n'))
+    data, style, shebang = modify_module('fake_module', 'fake_path', {}, templar,
+                                          task_vars={'ansible_python_interpreter': '/opt/python'})
+    assert shebang == '#!/opt/python -I'
+    assert data.startswith(b'#!/opt/python -I\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n')
